create_sana_img2img_pipeline: create a SanaSprintImg2ImgPipeline for text-guided image-to-image generation with SANA Sprint model
encode_prompt_text: encode a text prompt into Gemma transformer hidden state embeddings with attention mask
prepare_latents_image: prepare noisy latents from an input image at a given timestep using SCM cosine schedule
run_denoising_loop: run the diffusion denoising loop with transformer noise prediction and scheduler step
decode_latents_image: decode denoised latents through VAE decoder and postprocess to PIL image output
